description: Na₆(SO₄)₂FCl crystallizes in the cubic Fm̅3m space group. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four equivalent O, one Cl, and one F atom. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.39 Å. The Na-Cl bond length is 2.78 Å. The Na-F bond length is 2.22 Å. S is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four equivalent O atoms. All S-O bond lengths are 1.48 Å. O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three equivalent Na and one S atom. Cl is bonded to six equivalent Na atoms to form ClNa₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent FNa₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. F is bonded to six equivalent Na atoms to form FNa₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent ClNa₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted.
